text:
[issue by ako256]
### Minecraft Version

1.21.11

### Mod Loader

Fabric

### Describe the Issue

Hi! I've been playing this combo of minecraft mods since december and after some mod updates in the last week of December (approx, before jan 18 for sure), the game keeps crashing whenever I click on an activated waystone.

Steps:
1. open any world in minecraft
2. click on a waystone (pre-generated or placed in creative)
3. after it gets activated, click again for crash

[comment by ako256 (none)]
I feel stupid, but basically the balm and waystones mod versions didn't match. Balm is on 21.11.6 while waystones is at 21.11.4

It's working now after downgrading both to 21.11.2
Modrinth doesn't seem to have Balm version 21.11.4

[comment by BlayTheNinth (member)]
The versions don't have to match. As long as they're both for the correct Minecraft version and mod loader, they should load up and work fine (or display an error on startup if minimum versions aren't met).

However, I'm also unable to reproduce the issue. Balm 21.11.6 includes Kuma, so I'm not sure why it's not loading in your instance. The `balm-fabric-1.21.11-21.11.6.jar` should be 841.7 KiB and contain `META-INF/jars/kuma-api-fabric-21.11.12.jar` in its archive.

Please upload the full `latest.log` file if the issue persists after reinstalling Balm from Modrinth or CurseForge.

[comment by ako256 (none)]
Tried reinstalling it after removing both waystones and balm, still the same issue. Here's the latest.log file:

[latest.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24844284/latest.log)

[comment by ako256 (none)]
I tried it with a new profile with no other mods, it seems to work fine with just balm, fabric API and waystones mods installed

[comment by BlayTheNinth (member)]
Try updating Fabric Loader to 0.18.4 (in the instance's settings), it seems to be an issue on older versions of Fabric Loader.

[comment by ako256 (none)]
Yep, updating the fabric loader to 0.18.4 fixed it! Thanks a lot!
